breakdown.method: Batch score = lowest page score (07-judge.md; config pass_threshold 90); the batch has one page, /ur/plan/, whose score is its lowest key (plan.routeLimit, plan.empty.d, plan.shared.h = 91). Each key scored on five axes: accuracy 30, nativeness 30, termbase/transliteration/orthography 20, fit for the Urdu-speaking traveller 10, structure 10. The axes below are the page minimums and sum to 91. Round 3 (last round): no text change; the 26 strings are the round-2 strings byte for byte, so every key keeps its round-2 score. The third fresh blind reader gave 72/100 (0 serious, 9 medium, 9 minor): a reading, not the score; each of its 18 items repeats a point of reader r0 or r1 and is ruled on the existing rulings (see blind_reader_rulings), on source or template design (source_defects) or as a tool artefact.

accuracy.note: plan.empty.d -1: the source's two verbs (click, tap) are one neutral verb «چنیں» (N730, owner decision 2026-10-21, cost already charged by N332). plan.location -1: «نقشے پر» is not in either source but names the link's real target (N731). plan.routeLimit/plan.empty.h: «زیادہ سے زیادہ» and «ابھی» are entailed or carried by the Arabic, no deduction. The new routeLimit clause (N739) says what the source says (the route opens with the first 10) and adds no fact. No fact, number or name added; both 10s Latin.

nativeness.note: plan.shared.h -2: «اشتراک کردہ» is stiff (reader r0 #8, r1 #6); kept under N733 because the fallback «کی اشتراک کی گئی» stacks «کی … کی» and the loan «شیئر» is refused (P16-test). plan.routeLimit -2: the heavy participle «کھلنے والے راستے» is gone (N739), but «پڑاؤ» can read as a camp (N734 binds) and «قبول کرتا ہے» is a software verb that two readers took for a calque. plan.empty.d -1: «چنیں» for acting on a button is the line's neutral verb, not the everyday phone word. Published phrases «اس آلے پر», «بنا بنایا راستہ پا لیں», «محفوظ کردہ» are chatty or official but bind by sibling consistency.

termbase_style.note: plan.shared.h -1: «اشتراک کردہ» participle of the N3 verb, no termbase entry of its own. «پڑاؤ» is still status pending (no dictionary page read in the line). Letterforms, digits, punctuation, quotes, P22 pronouns, P2 head name, brands and P16-admitted loans all clean (stage 5 list and verify.mjs OK).

fit_for_traveller.note: -1: the shared-list box (paragraph plus «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات دیکھیں») can be misread as viewing the shared list; that is the source's design (SD-M2) and the Urdu keeps faith. Labels are short, the counter reads as a count line, the confirm is one question ending in «؟».

structure.note: 26 keys in pack order; no placeholder, markup or link in any string; Latin 10 twice in plan.routeLimit and nothing else; the arrow follows one space; plan.title equals ui.nav.myTrip and plan.empty.browse equals the published sibling byte for byte.
